================================================================================
SECTION 1: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY & DUAL-EDITION ARCHITECTURE
================================================================================
ZothOS provides two complementary sovereign Linux distributions engineered for autonomous AI agents, offensive security operators, and zero-telemetry privacy:

1. ZothOS v3.4.0 (Full KDE Plasma 6 Wayland Workstation):
   - Debian 13 (Trixie) + Linux 6.12 Hybrid UEFI with surgical APT pinning (900 Debian Trixie, 400 Kali Rolling & Parrot Security).
   - 23+ localhost loopback system daemons bound strictly to 127.0.0.1, anchored by Sovereign Agent Bridge (:8102), STDP Neuro-Memory (:8094), Vaēlor L1 PoUW DAG (:8140), Zoth Sovereign Vault (:8787), Zoth-Relay (:8765), and Zoth Civilization (:9393).
   - 80 preloaded sovereign tools (56 client-side Web/WebGPU workstations + 24 CLI/daemon engines across 79 public GitHub repositories).
   - Hermes-Zoth orchestrator plugin bridging Nous Research Hermes Agent into local MCP clusters and Ring 0–3 kernel sandboxes.
   - Hardware-enforced < 55.0°C thermal ceiling (no_turbo=1, 0 RPM silent passive fan curve, monitored by zoth-sentinel & zoth-heal).

2. ZothOS-Lite v1.2 (https://zothos-lite.nullai.tech — Amnesic Monotone Live USB/ISO OS):
   - Tails-style Monotone (#F7F7F4 Alabaster / #000000 Ink) Live ISO (~400 MB) booting 100% into volatile RAM (`toram noswap`) for zero forensic host trace on universal x86_64 hardware.
   - Supports 56 curated AI models across 8 providers (Ollama Local, Hermes/Nous featuring DeepSeek Flash, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Groq).
   - Integrated ZothNet 3-hop Sphinx mixnet (https://zothnet.nullai.tech) for metadata-resistant onion packet transport.
   - Optional USB LUKS2 or encrypted cloud persistence (`zoth-lite-storage`), Chain of Thoughts (`zoth-cot`) SHA-256 Merkle working memory DAG, and AZOTH embodied U+2800 Braille AI + Kokoro 82M ONNX Neural TTS.
